purpose: Evaluate structure policy, assay harmonization, lineage, attrition, modeling handoff and evidence boundaries.

cases.task: Curate mixed SMILES and SDF records into standardized molecular entities.
must_include: explicit salt charge stereo tautomer and protomer policy
must_not: overwrite raw structures
silently remove stereochemistry
call a standardized form the unique true molecule

cases.task: Harmonize bioactivity records from several assays.
must_include: target construct species and assay context
endpoint relation original value and units
must_not: average IC50 Ki and Kd as one endpoint
convert inequality relations to exact values
hide source or measurement-level records

cases.task: Audit a curated molecular property dataset before modeling.
must_not: rewrite data during a read-only audit
treat parse success as chemical validity
claim leakage is solved without group keys

cases.task: Prepare a curated endpoint dataset for an ML benchmark.
must_include: structure scaffold replicate source and time group keys
handoff to ml-benchmarking for split and model comparison
must_not: fit preprocessing using test labels
select a random split as final validation
claim model readiness from curation alone

cases.task: Handle a request that continues from curation into candidate ranking.
must_include: no ranking claim before downstream review
must_not: invent a campaign score
treat structural alerts as safety proof
drop missing candidates to improve rank

cases.task: Handle structures that cannot be parsed or reconciled.
must_not: silently discard failures
guess missing stereochemistry
replace a structure from an unrecorded source

cases.task: Canonical structures exist but acyclic scaffold keys are empty and tautomer groups unassessed.
must_include: assay context distinct from chemical identity
must_not: declare readiness from canonical SMILES
aggregate compounds solely by assay context
